status: D04-frozen; sample counts and seed identities are owned by D07

scenario.heldOutRule: The four equal-attribute diagonal combinations are never present as targets or distractors in training or validation; each attribute value remains represented in the seen pool.

splits.train: Seen target and candidate pool; policy updates enabled.
splits.validation: Same seen type support under an independent split PRNG domain; policy updates disabled; tuning and baseline selection only.
splits.held-out: Target restricted to the four unseen diagonal combinations; policy updates disabled; accessed once after lock.
splits.evaluation: All-type engineering/qualification surface; prohibited as a confirmatory test split.

duplicateRules: No scenarioRef or stateHash may occur in more than one split.
No held-out type code may occur anywhere in a training or validation candidate set.
No held-out target may occur in training or validation.
Every held-out type must appear as a held-out target before analysis is complete.
Asset-backed scenarios must be deduplicated by normalized asset SHA-256 and semantic source identifier before quarantine approval.
Near-duplicate image or audio thresholds are not yet applicable to the numeric generator and must be registered before adding asset-backed bundles.

budgetDimensions: trainable parameter count where the architecture is shared
measured CPU/GPU time and peak memory as reported diagnostics

comparisonRules.architecture: independent per-role single-layer GRU policy, 4,049 trainable parameters per role
mayDiffer: loss function required by the intervention
comparisonRules.claim: Randomized or paired within-architecture mechanism and ablation effects may receive causal interpretation.

comparisonRules.architecture: same recurrent architecture and initialization rule in both arms
comparisonRules.claim: The registered arm contrast isolates the assigned bandwidth condition within the tested architecture.

comparisonRules.architecture: same recurrent learner in all carrier arms
mayDiffer: fixed token, unfamiliar glyph, bitmap, stroke, or tone physical grammar
comparisonRules.claim: Carrier assignment effects may receive causal interpretation; larger physical grammar capacity is reported separately and is not learner capacity.

comparisonRules.architecture: same frozen trained recurrent policies at evaluation
mayDiffer: none, declared six, permuted six, opaque six, or derived display mapping
comparisonRules.claim: Assigned affect-display effects may receive causal interpretation within the registered threat model.

comparisonRules.architecture: same recurrent family for the primary new-partner contrast
mayDiffer: fixed dyad versus eight-partner round-robin exposure
comparisonRules.claim: The same-architecture degradation difference may receive causal interpretation; cross-architecture replacement is secondary.

comparisonRules.architecture: same frozen cooperative starting policies and scenario slots
mayDiffer: registered utilities, reservation values, and private-information condition
comparisonRules.claim: Paired incentive-condition effects may receive causal interpretation.

comparisonRules.architecture: frozen pretrained model versus recurrent learned policies or a different partner architecture
comparisonRules.claim: Report effects and uncertainty as descriptive benchmarks; do not attribute differences causally to the learning mechanism.
